summary: Adapted the mythic-catch check to the new feature: mythic_marlin now gets its own 25s fangvideo (/videos/mythic-catch.mp4) via the shared CatchVideo component before the CatchReward 'mythic' variant (formerly MythicCatch.tsx, now unified with LegendaryCatch into CatchReward.tsx). Discovered and fixed a real selector regression across 4 PRE-EXISTING checks: since legendary's and mythic's <video> elements now stay permanently co-mounted (both preload simultaneously), the shared data-testid='fishing-catch-video-overlay' resolves to 2 DOM nodes, breaking strict-mode Playwright locators that previously assumed a single instance. Rescoped all affected checks to the currently-active (non-'.invisible') overlay instance; all pass again. Backend suite unaffected (83/83, no DB changes in this UI-only feature).
action_items: Stale browser check 'leonida-fishing-full-game-flow' (from iteration 9, targets an obsolete canvas mini-game UI) remains un-fixed per scope -- unrelated to this feature, not re-run this iteration since it was already carried as a known note in iteration 50 and no criterion in this briefing touches it.
